by {
  cases IsFreeGroup.exists_generators G with gens is_free_gens,
  let H_gen : Set ↥H := {x | ∃ g ∈ gens, x = (↑(quotient.mk coset_eq) g)},
  have H_gen_subset : H_gen ⊆ H := fun x h => h,
  have H_gen_span : ∀ h ∈ H, h ∈ subgroup.span H_gen := fun h h_in_H => 
    begin
      rcases h_in_H with ⟨g, hg⟩,
      exact mem_span_self _ (mem_set_of_exists.mk g hg)
    end,
  have H_gen_gen : ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ g ∈ H_gen, h = (↑(quotient.mk coset_eq) g),
    from fun h h_in_H => 
      begin
        rcases h_in_H with ⟨g, hg⟩,
        exact ⟨g, mem_set_of_exists.mk g hg⟩
      end,
  have H_gen_independent : ∀ (s : Set ↥H) (i : ℕ), (∀ j ≠ i, s j ≠ 0) → (∀ j, s j ∈ subgroup.span H_gen) → s i ∈ subgroup.span H_gen,
    from fun s i hi => 
      begin
        rw subgroup.span_eq_ideal at H_gen_span,
        exact subgroup.span_independent_iff.1 (is_free_group.span_independent is_free_gens) s i hi H_gen_span
      end,
  have H_is_free : IsFreeGroup ↥H :=
    begin
      use H_gen,
      split,
      {
        intro h,
        exact H_gen_independent h 0 (fun j hj => H_gen_span hj) (fun j hj => H_gen_span hj)
      },
      {
        intro h,
        exact H_gen_gen h
      }
    end
}
